notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (plain curl) allowed generic User-agent (only checkout/account/order paths disallowed, no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entries) so tier (c) was not blocked by robots. Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl, browser UA) was blocked immediately: homepage returned HTTP 403 and sitemap_index.xml returned a PerimeterX px-captcha wall. Escalated to tier (b) Playwright headless chromium: also returned HTTP 403 'Access to this page has been denied' (same PerimeterX). Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome: loaded normally, used for the entire research pass. TREE: built from the union of the mega-menu (Living Room/Bedroom/Kitchen&Dining/Mattresses/Home Decor/Home Office/Baby&Kids/Outdoor) plus each relevant landing page's own 'Shop by Category' sub-nav: /c/home-decor/ (Storage Baskets, Rugs, Pillows & Blankets -> textiles page), /c/home-decor/home-accents/ (Curtains and Drapes, Storage and Organization, Baskets and Boxes), /c/rugs/ (Area/Outdoor/Runner/Accent/Kids Rugs + sidebar Round Rugs/Doormats), /c/bedding/ (9 subcategories), /c/bathroom/ (Bathroom Storage, Wastebaskets & Hampers), /c/outdoor/patio-accessories/ (Furniture Covers). QTY: read from each leaf's own '1 - 30 of N products' / 'N items' header after confirming the page h1 matched the requested node. EXCLUDED (h1/canonical mismatch = bad slug serving a different/parent page, confirmed per rule): 'Doormats' tile under Rugs (/c/rugs/all/2_x_3_under/) resolved to h1 "2' x 3' & Under Shop All Rugs" - a size filter, not a doormat category, so dropped. 'Baskets and Boxes' tile under Home Accents (/c/storage/boxes-and-totes/) redirected to the parent /c/storage/ page (h1 'Home Storage', same 389 count as the parent) - dropped as a broken/aliased slug. EXCLUDED (Furniture boundary, storage.md Furniture Boundary/Storage Furniture Boundary rules): /c/storage/ 'Home Storage' (389 products; FAQ literally headed 'Frequently Asked Storage Furniture Questions'; contents are dressers, TV stands, bookcases, storage beds, accent cabinets - Furniture domain, already Furniture.xlsx territory) and /c/kids/storage/ 'Kids Storage' (30 products; breadcrumb 'Kids Furniture > Storage'; contents are bookcases, nightstands, dressers plus a few toy bins - Furniture-dominant, excluded consistent with the above). EXCLUDED (not Textile/Storage): Poufs (furniture/ottoman), Wall Decor 764 products (canvas art, mirrors, wall clocks - no tapestries/textile wall hangings found), Home Accents decorative nodes (Candles, Decorative Objects/Vases, Sculptures, Picture Frames, Canisters/Jars, Bowls/Trays, Mirrors) - Decorative Home Accessories task territory, Bathroom Vanities/Fixtures&Hardware/Lighting/Mirrors/Wall Art, Kitchen & Dining furniture pages (no kitchen linens/towel category found on site). LOW-CONFIDENCE / REVIEW QUEUE: 'Wastebaskets & Hampers' (qty 4, final URL /c/bathroom-laundry/) mixes trash cans (not Storage per rules) with laundry hampers (valid Storage per storage.md S11) on one un-splittable listing page - flagged LOW. 'Bed Pillows' (qty 55, /c/bedding/bed-pillows/) - sleep-pillow inserts under the Bedding hierarchy; textile.md S3 lists Pillowcases/Shams but not the pillow insert itself, so flagged MEDIUM rather than HIGH.
